market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor activist and not a nationally competitive candidate. Second place in Brazil's presidential elections consistently goes to well-known figures from major parties; his likelihood of outpolling top-tier opponents is negligible. The market's ~5.8% chance is far above a realistic 1% estimate.
evidence_points: Second place in recent Brazilian elections has been held by major candidates (Bolsonaro, Haddad, etc.) from dominant parties.
Renan Santos lacks significant name recognition, party machinery, or poll numbers indicating a second-place finish.
There is no credible scenario in which a fringe leftist candidate surpasses PT, PL, or other mainstream parties' nominees.
